summary: Spire Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its sale of all membership interests in Belle Butte LLC (which owns Spire Storage West and Spire Storage Salt Plains) to Subterra Energy Borrower, an affiliate of I Squared Capital, for total consideration of $657 million. The consideration consists of $607 million cash at closing (subject to customary adjustments) and $50 million deferred consideration payable by September 30, 2027. The board approved the transaction; no advisor named. The deal closed following HSR Act waiting period expiration and other customary conditions. Net proceeds will support regulated utility operations, capex, and debt reduction. Watch for use of proceeds and any further restructuring.
